response.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0

assumptions.assumption: 'Higher side' of the dividing line at 1.0 means points > 1.0 (strictly greater than), excluding the boundary value itself

alternatives.interpretation: If the dividing line should be inclusive on the higher side (points >= 1.0)
